sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Stop the bleeding: tarp the roof, shut the water — insurers require mitigation. Document: photos, video, and a written inventory before cleanup. File: report promptly and keep every receipt; additional living expenses may be covered. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
